== Usage ==
{{ItemInfo
|type = Sword
|name = Glacial Scythe

|item_ability_activation = Right Click

The '''Glacial Scythe'''{{'}}s {{AN|Ice Bolt}} ability fires a bolt of ice in the direction the player is looking, dealing {{Red|1,500}} damage and slowing mobs within {{Green|0.5}} blocks of the projectile for {{Green|5s}}. If the ice bolt hits a block, it creates a {{Green|3}} block explosion that deals its regular damage.

== Tips ==
* The {{AN|Ice Bolt}} projectile deals damage twice. Firstly when it passes an enemy, and when it hits a block, at which point it explodes for AoE damage. Therefore by aiming at mobs' legs or at mobs standing in front of a wall, you can double your damage. The explosion damage can be increased with {{Item|Implosion Belt}}, leading to a total of a {{Red|2.25x}} increase in damage if both hits land.
